cp nuxt.config.ts /tmp/nuxt.config.bak; sed -i "s|  modules: \['@nuxt/content'\],|  modules: ['@nuxt/content'],\n  vite: { build: { minify: false } },|" nuxt.config.ts; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?; pkill -f 'bun .output/server/index.mjs$' ; sleep 0.5; (PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; sed -e 's/disableJavaScriptEvaluation: false, disableJavaScriptFileLoading: false, errorCapture: .processLevel., navigation: {}, }/enableJavaScriptEvaluation: true, suppressInsecureJavaScriptEnvironmentWarning: true }/' /tmp/hd/t.ts > ./.hd-test.ts; timeout 150 bun ./.hd-test.ts 2>&1 | tail -30

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/pages/contact.vue'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''const sending = ref(false)
''','''const sending = ref(false)

  posted.value = null
})
''')

u=http://127.0.0.1:4702; for p in / /books /books/treasure-island /about /contact /nope /books/nope /books/; do echo "$p $(curl -s -H 'Accept: text/html' -o /tmp/p.html -w '%{http_code}' $u$p) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/p.html) $(grep -o 'aria-current="page"[^>]*>[^<]*' /tmp/p.html)"; done; curl -s -H 'Accept: text/html' $u/nope | grep -o '<div class="site">.*</footer>' | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g'

pgrep -af 'output/server' | grep -v pgrep; grep -c aaa-test .output/public/__nuxt_content/books/sql_dump.txt 2>/dev/null; bun run check >/dev/null 2>&1; echo CHECK $?
